label: Contradiction-4
title: K-004: How many systems are still unpatched?
description: The site's claim reads as 1.57 million unpatched out of about 2.6 million hosts (about 60%). The source says 1.57 million out of the 1.58 million whose version could be read (about 99%, on the day the fix shipped); the 2.58 million is all hosts seen, most of which do not announce a version. The two framings give very different pictures. The BBC's 90% has no named counter or method and is not captured. Open, because the site states one framing as fact.

comments.author: cli-user
comments.text: Run-3: the site now gives Censys's denominator (1.58 million version-readable hosts) beside VulnCheck's 2.6 million; the BBC's 90_ stays uncaptured and unattributed.
